name: io.github.n24q02m/mnemo
description: Persistent AI memory with hybrid search. Open, free, unlimited.

environmentVariables.description: API key for the [models.embed] provider cell; overrides the cell's api_key in ~/.mnemo/config.toml. With no key for the cell, embeddings use the local ONNX model unless DISABLE_LOCAL_EMBED is set.
environmentVariables.name: HULL_EMBED_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: API key for the [models.rerank] provider cell; overrides the cell's api_key in ~/.mnemo/config.toml. With no key for the cell, reranking uses the local ONNX model unless DISABLE_LOCAL_RERANK is set.
environmentVariables.name: HULL_RERANK_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: API key for the [models.chat] provider cell (entity extraction, consolidate); overrides the cell's api_key in ~/.mnemo/config.toml.
environmentVariables.name: HULL_CHAT_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: API key for the [models.jev_score] provider cell (importance scoring); overrides the cell's api_key in ~/.mnemo/config.toml. With no key for the cell, importance defaults to 0.5.
environmentVariables.name: HULL_JEV_SCORE_API_KEY
